page.overview:
Who is Ordez?

Ordez was a Human male Sith Lord who served the Falleen Dark Councilor Darth Karrid during the Galactic War. He wielded a massive double-bladed lightsaber that produced identical beams of red-black energy.

Ordez and fellow Sith Lord Quux were assigned to the Ascendant Spear in the year 3640 BBY to serve the newly appointed member of the Dark Council, Darth Karrid.

When Jedi Master Gnost-Dural broke free from his restraints with the help of SIS Operative Theron Shan, he went to confront his former pupil, Darth Karrid in the chambers in which she could control the Spear.

When Gnost-Dural arrived, he was met with Lord Ordez, Lord Quux and Karrid's Human Male Apprentice, all of which were meditating in order to support Karrid in controlling the Ascendant Spear. When they saw Dural enter, the trio stopped their meditation and engaged the Jedi Master in a duel. Ordez and Quux together were powerful enough to hold off Gnost-Dural, the only problem being that they were not coordinated, constantly interrupting each others attacks, this allowed the Jedi to kill Karrid's Apprentice and focus on the other two.
